ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.12:0.88 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling concentrated on the inner-mid section of the right lobe; sparse white focal spots (1-4 pixels) distributed across the predominantly black field of both lobes; dense white/yellowish pixel clusters on distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate aperture of 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 0.4 relative to the notch width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-12 pixels along the continuous trailing edge of the right lobe; left lobe trailing edge displays similar jagged topography above the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the superior boundary of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense circular clusters of high-intensity pixels (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered individual white rosettes (3-6 pixels diameter) across the central ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, diagonal white linear marks (rake marks) on the mid-left lobe; two shorter parallel white scratches on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (acorn barnacles) on distal tips and trailing edges; multiple white rake marks visible on the ventral surface pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'fringed' texture on the lateral tips caused by multi-layered barnacle colonization, distinct from the primary trailing edge serration pattern.
